snippet.title: Mizuki and the Crimson Moon Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Mizuki in this 2D platformer adventure as she protects her village and saves Japan! Utilize her unique ability of teleportation to overcome tricky obstacles and deadly foes!
The Mizuki and the Crimson Moon Demo is released today on Itch.IO
Due to some verification delays, the Steam Demo will not be released until July 19th.
Wishlist the game on Steam and follow the Itch.IO page to keep up to date with progress on Mizuki and the Crimson Moon!
